newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends hectic afternoon trade down versus dlr.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends hectic afternoon trade down versus dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed Wednesday afternoon trade slightly easier against the dollar but firmer on the day as hectic dollar selling followed Bundesbank denied comments that the dollar should gain further.
The forint closed at 173.43/49, compared with 173.30.35 at midday and 173.90/95 at the opening, dealers said.
"We like the Buba. It's always on our side" said Attila Behan of ING Bank. "Whenever things get out out of hand, it says the right thing, the dollar comes down and we make a profit."
Dealers said turmoil on international markets was reflected in Hungary.
